title: Bhairavi
brief_description: Ornamented relief of Bhairavi on a plaque of stone
detailed_description: Ornamented relief of Bhairavi on a plaque of stone seated in vajrasan posture holding lotus in right hand and a damaru in left hand. She is attended by two female chamara (flywhisk) bearers on either side. The image is bordered by an ornamental band with torana decoration and a kirtimukha in the centre. Two elephants are represented below the deity. The crude sculpture is in low relief.
